I haven't saved the mail draft to Ottilie yet. It's waiting for June Osei-Lark to approve it.

- **Why it needs approval:** a per-seat rate counts as a finance figure. That kind of figure can only go to Anselm, June or the account owner without approval. The Sierra cheat sheet lists Florian as the Dreyness Brewing Co. owner, and Ottilie is on the Canyon team, not the account.
- **What I did:** I logged the approval request and replied to Florian in his #sierra-random thread. The reply shows him the draft text and asks June there for her OK. June is in that channel, and Florian had already posted the $1,597 figure there, so repeating it in the thread was fine.
- **The draft:** it goes to oellford@pemberline.com, which the directory shows, with the subject "Dreyness 2027 rate". The body gives the proposed 2027 rate of $1,597 a seat for the Kestrel pricing review, and says it comes from Florian's call yesterday and isn't in any document yet.
- **After June approves:** I'll save it as a draft for Florian to send himself. It's an internal pemberline.com address, so Ruth's approval isn't needed.
